_about: Context for translators: where and when each message is spoken. Not loaded by the mod. Keep short: messages are spoken by a screen reader, so the most important word comes first.
loaded: Spoken once when the game starts with the mod.
no_history: Speech history keys (Shift+[ / Shift+]) pressed while nothing has been spoken yet.
history_start: Prefix before the oldest history entry, when going back past the start. Keep the trailing space.
history_newest: Prefix before the newest history entry, when going forward past the end. Keep the trailing space.
position: Position in a menu list, said after the item name: {0} = item number, {1} = number of items. Example: 'Load game, 2 of 5'.
press_any_key: Title screen, before the menu appears (the game waits for a key press).
title_new_game: Title screen menu item. Use the official name from the game in your language if it exists.
title_load: Title screen menu item (load a save file).
title_continue: Title screen menu item (resume from the quick save).
title_quit: Title screen menu item (exit the game).
gender_male: New game: choice of the main character, male.
gender_female: New game: choice of the main character, female.
diff_beginner: New game: difficulty level. Use the game's official names.
diff_normal: New game: difficulty level (the default choice).
name_entry_intro: Name entry screen (signing the contract), spoken when it opens.
name_typed: Name entry: the name typed so far, spoken when a letter is added or removed. {0} = the name.
name_empty: Name entry: the last letter was removed, the name is empty.
key_capital: Name entry: an upper-case letter on the keyboard. {0} = the letter. Lower-case letters are spoken alone.
sym_repeat: Name entry key: 々 (Japanese iteration mark).
sym_dot: Name entry key: • (dot in the middle of the line).
name_auto: Name entry with the automatic signature setting on: spoken when the mod fills in the names. {0} = last name, {1} = first name (from the mod settings).
name_auto_press_start: Name entry: the automatic signature filled in the names but the game did not take the Start button; the player must press Start. Start is on the keys with scan codes 44 and 45 by default (Z and X on QWERTY, W and X on AZERTY): name the keys of a common keyboard of your language.
sys_menu: Start-of-game system menu (Config, Load, Title...), spoken when it opens, before the first entry.
sys_delete: System menu entry: delete save data (the picture says SUPPRIMER).
sys_load: System menu entry: load a saved game.
sys_title: System menu entry: back to the title screen (the game then asks to confirm).
sys_end_game: System menu entry: quit the game (the game then asks to confirm).
sys_unknown: System menu: an entry the mod does not know. {0} = its number.
camp_menu: Pause menu (camp), spoken when it opens, before the first entry.
camp_skill: Pause menu entry. The game's help line follows.
save_slot: Save / load screen: the selected save slot, before its contents (date, level, play time...). {0} = slot number.
